page.title: Development Journal
page.description: Follow how this product is evolving through milestones, product decisions and implementation notes.

editorial-system.title: Editorial System Milestone
editorial-system.summary: Nine2Fire moved from early positioning into a more structured editorial system, shaping how long-form content, practical tools and public learning can live together in one product.

product-architecture.title: Product Architecture Milestone
product-architecture.summary: deckLog moved beyond interface ideas and started defining its product vocabulary, domain boundaries and operational structure.

fleet-explorer.title: Fleet Explorer
fleet-explorer.summary: The first fleet overview started taking shape with reusable cards, localized copy and a clearer structure for browsing boats and operational status.
